title: On Integrating the newcomers into the village
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：integrate　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 integrate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the painter ① integrated the newcomers into the village without complaint, and every visitor in the studio said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the painter ② integrates the newcomers into the village with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ integrate the newcomers into the village at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ integrated the newcomers into the village before — a line in the catalogue for May 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Integrating the newcomers into the village without complaint, the painter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ integrate the two sets of accounts with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Integrate the two sets of accounts at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue, and a new visitor from the next studio ⑧ integrates the two sets of accounts without complaint every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the easel, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ integrated the newcomers into the village again when nobody else would.

⑩ To integrate the newcomers into the village, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the studio remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the studio forgets, somebody integrates the newcomers into the village with great care again and somebody must integrate the newcomers into the village without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 融合（一般过去式 integrated the newcomers into the village：1987 年画师头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 融合（一般现在 integrates the newcomers into the village：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 融合（不定式 to integrate the newcomers into the village：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 融合（过去完成时 had integrated the newcomers into the village：1981 年五月的展品目录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 融合（动名词 integrating the newcomers into the village 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 并入（integrate the two sets of accounts：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去并入把两套账目并到一处）
G. v. 并入（integrate the two sets of accounts：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 融合（后段两处：新来的观者照例 integrates the two sets of accounts，而母亲又一次 integrated the newcomers into the village）

answers.why: integrate 意为“融合”，1987 年画师毫无怨言地融合把新来的人融进村子，那是画室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 integrated。
integrate 意为“融合”，自那以后画师小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 integrates。
integrate 意为“融合”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯融合把新来的人融进村子”，此处为不定式 to integrate the newcomers into the village。
integrate 意为“融合”，展品目录里 五月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人融合过，故用过去完成时 had integrated。
integrate 意为“融合”，画师说“融合把新来的人融进村子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 integrating the newcomers into the village 作主语。
integrate 意为“并入”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去并入把两套账目并到一处”，should ever 之后用原形 integrate the two sets of accounts。
integrate 意为“并入”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻并入把两套账目并到一处（integrate the two sets of accounts at once），以后再也不要提起。
integrate 意为“融合”，新来的观者每个季度都照例并入把两套账目并到一处，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 integrates。
integrate 意为“融合”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地融合把新来的人融进村子，用一般过去式 integrated 叙述。
integrate 意为“融合”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要融合把新来的人融进村子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和画室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。

多年以后，画师仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（integrates the newcomers into the village）

画师说过，毫无怨言地融合把新来的人融进村子这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（integrating the newcomers into the village 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻并入把两套账目并到一处，以后再也不要提起。（integrate the two sets of accounts，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 integrate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the painter integrated the newcomers into the village without complaint, and nobody in the studio forgot it.
Even now the painter integrates the newcomers into the village with great care whenever the studio asks.
Integrating the newcomers into the village without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever integrate the two sets of accounts with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next studio integrates the two sets of accounts without complaint every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother integrated the newcomers into the village again, and the studio remembered that half.
